decisions.question: Should a separate model client or performance observer be used?
decisions.decision: No. All model work uses this conversation and its in-session agents; deterministic local rendering and data tools remain allowed.

decisions.question: Are resident workflow MCP tools available in this conversation?
decisions.decision: No workflow tools are exposed. Reuse the same deterministic renderer through a narrow experiment wrapper, retaining immutable file references instead of reproducing data in messages. Do not change client configuration or launch another session.

decisions.question: Can request-to-completion time be measured from before the first marker?
decisions.decision: The first exact parent UTC marker is retained; preparation before it is unmeasured. Per-stage agents record their own start/input-ready/end events. Do not present incomplete wall-clock attribution as pure reasoning.

decisions.question: Do the 12 primary scenarios fully represent authored crop and saving-busy interfaces?
decisions.decision: Require two explicit related scenes: s08-source-rectangle and s11-video-saving-busy. Keep primary scenario identities unchanged; add only the consequential states before timed runs.

decisions.question: How should the initially unspecified stopped-editor sample state be chosen?
decisions.decision: Freeze common fixture values: frame 0, stopped/Fit, saved project, unsaved video draft, no Undo/Redo history, no global operation, Track 1 active and Append insertion. These are test-state choices, not new product rules.

decisions.question: Can reported model aliases establish actual model settings?
decisions.decision: Record explicit requested model/effort separately; actual backend settings remain unverified unless exposed by runtime metadata. Corrected the feasibility layout receipt without changing its artifact.

decisions.question: Does the shared renderer support real video/raster media?
decisions.decision: Use schematic media in both paths and record the fidelity limitation externally. No new renderer or asset-generation route is introduced.
